findings.title: NetworkPolicy blocks all traffic to a Service
findings.cause: NetworkPolicy default-deny selects every pod behind Service web and allows no ingress, so nothing can connect to it

evidence.what: NetworkPolicy selects pods with any labels (every pod in the namespace) and has no ingress rules
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy default-deny -n kd-networkpolicy-deny-all -o jsonpath='{.spec}'

evidence.what: Service web has 1 ready pods, all selected by ingress policies with no rules

findings.fix: Add an ingress rule that allows the Service's clients (by namespace or pod labels and port) to a NetworkPolicy that selects these pods, if web is not meant to be closed.
